newsitem.title: USA: Calypte in pact with Trinity on HIV test.
newsitem.headline: Calypte in pact with Trinity on HIV test.

text.p: Calypte Biomedical Corp Wednesday said it entered into a collaborative research and product development pact with Trinity Biotech Plc of Dublin to develop a rapid, one-step HIV test which can be performed on urine samples.

The test would be as simple to perform as a home pregnancy test and would provide results in as little as 10 minutes. The test would be performed by dipping a test unit into a urine sample, and after waiting 10 minutes, reading the result by looking for a red line in the test unit's viewing window, Calypte said.

"We are very excited about the prospects for a rapid urine HIV test. By combining each company's unique talents, we expect to create a test which is not only accurate, but simple enough and fast enough to address a wide variety of HIV testing needs worldwide," said Ronan O'Caoimh, chief executive of Trinity.

Calypte is the exclusive licensee of several patents related to urine HIV testing. In August 1996, Calypte received the first U.S. Food and Drug Administration license for a urine HIV-1 antibody test. That test is designed for use in high-volume, professional laboratories, and laboratory equipment is required to perform it.
Trinity Biotech markets home pregnancy tests in the U.S. and has been marketing a rapid blood HIV test called SeroCard internationally since 1994.
